# Uncle Dave

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Uncle Dave is viewed by others as having a somewhat prejudiced outlook. In particular, he holds a strong skepticism toward modern surgical techniques, which he dismisses as new-fangled notions.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P17](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P20](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0020)_

## Traits

- presumed a little prejudiced  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P17](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0017)</sub>
- prejudiced against modern surgery  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P20](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0020)</sub>

## History

Twelve years prior, Uncle Dave advised [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) that nothing could be done to help [Dick](../character/dick.md). He later counselled [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md) to leave well enough alone regarding Dick's condition. However, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) disagreed with this perspective, believing it was his duty to inform [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) about a potential surgical procedure that could restore Dick's sanity.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P3](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P5](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P6](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P7](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P8](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P9](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0009), +39 more_
